title: Nor’easter Live Updates: Heavy Rain and Wind Batter Northeast, Bringing Coastal Flooding
summary: The storm flooded low-lying areas, knocked out power for thousands and forced the cancellation of several major events and hundreds of flights. Wind gusts exceeded 50 miles per hour in places.
